newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 20.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones rose 50.69 points to 6,397.60. PLDT's ADR slid by 50 cents to $60.
* The peso closed on Tuesday at 26.253 to a U.S. dollar from 26.262
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,109.02, up 3.47.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate was up at 12.5625 from 11.46875 pct
* BPI Securities advises its clients to invest selectively in stocks with good 1997 prospects, with special attention to index-linked stocks especially the new additions to the index.

* Philippine Asia Equity Securities says Steniel went up 10 percent yesterday on rumours that the company has sold its high cost inventory, sold its Pasig plant and will consolidate operations in its new plant in Cavite.
* Manila Times says Waterfront Philippines Inc is a cheap entry point for investors who are eager to play the country's fast growing gaming industry.
* The Business Daily says Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co is opening up talks with two Malaysian carriers on a $20 million communication faclity that will link Sabah to Mindanao.
* Inquirer says Philippine Realty and Holdings Corp has entered into a joint venture agreement to develop a 200-hectare property in Rizal, east of Manila.
